description: This source file implements buffer management and state-access functions for handling chunked HTTP message bodies within a specific object (HttpMbo Chunked Object). It includes functions for retrieving entity size, arrived size, expected size, appending body and chunk data, copying the body from internal buffers, and managing chunk information.

classes.name: HTTP_MBO_CHUNKED_OBJECT
classes.description: The object representing the HTTP Mbo Chunked message with state management for chunked transfer encoding.

classes.name: HTTP_CHUNK_INFO
classes.description: Structure holding information about individual chunks, specifically their size.

classes.name: HTTP_MESSAGE_BODY_OBJECT
classes.description: Object managing the message body, including buffer descriptors, size tracking, and synchronization locks.

methods.name: ULONG HttpMboChkGetEntitySize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Retrieves the total size of the entity body, considering the mode of operation and the buffer queue.

methods.name: ULONG HttpMboChkGetArrivedSize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Retrieves the size of data that has arrived so far, including chunk data and CRLFs.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpMboChkAppendBodyBdo(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hBdo)
methods.description: Appends a buffer descriptor representing a body part to the message, updating size counters accordingly.

methods.name: ULONG HttpMboChkGetExpectedSize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Calculates the total expected size of the remaining chunked message based on chunk info list.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpMboChkAppendChunkData(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hBdo,BOOL bHasCrlf)
methods.description: Appends chunk data to the message, handling CRLFs and updating transfer and entity sizes.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpMboChkCopyBodyFrom(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,PVOID buffer,PULONG pulSize)
methods.description: Copies the message body from internal buffer descriptors into an external buffer.
